title: Art style (animagine-lora-training/art-style.json)
description: Art style patterns for generated prompts.

patterns.description: One generated row per pattern, after pose. Empty or omitted emits one row without art style tags. positive is used in positive_prompt and caption_prompt; negative is used in negative_prompt only.

name.description: Stable identifier; used in filename_prefix. When positive is omitted or empty, name is the sole positive tag.
